invariants.rationale: The method always returns a Stream object, which may be empty but never null.
Parallelism is used as a hint for parallel operations; it should be positive.
flatMapToPairFunc is accessed and applied, so it must not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
reduceFunc is wrapped and executed, so it must not be null.
data.parallel() is called and would throw if data were null.
